2025_089_july_2025_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction register for July 2025, prepared for the Board of Education meeting of September 16, 2025. The ten-page listing, printed 9/11/25, itemizes each card charge with a transaction description, the journal-entry description "JULY 2025 PCARD EXP," an accounting code, a date and an amount, with refunds carried in a separate Credits column. Transaction dates run from 6/26/25 through 7/25/25, and the register closes with a stated total of 141,074.82. The single largest line is ROBERT BROOKE & ASSOC at 11,211.40 on 6/27/25.
